label: GO after a rewarded trial, moderately confident a1 choice, mid/late episode
explanation: Fires only at GO steps and only when the previous trial was rewarded (prev_reward==1 covers 100% of activations, but only 6% of such steps fire). Within that it is strongly biased toward the agent choosing a1 / good==S1 (~80% of mass), moderate positive policy logits (choice 2.8-8; weaker for very confident choices), mid-range value (never above ~8.1), and episode trials 30-89 (almost silent in the first 10 and last 10 trials). Activation grows across consecutive rewarded a1 trials within a window (streaks), max on long rewarded a1 runs in S1-good blocks. Never fires at D1 or D2, after an unrewarded trial, or after a D1 fixation error. Uses only observed/computed variables (prev reward, the agent own policy logit and value, episode time). Precision is clearly incomplete: the feature behaves like a graded internal variable that is only switched on in a subset of episodes, so the predicate is a partial description.
